baseline_candidate: factor1 at reference selected epoch; reproduce three inner fits and keep as fallback
width: frozen per seed/fold to reference budget600-selected width
constraint: combined inner equal-person MAE <= reference same-seed/fold selected inner MAE; zero slack
objective: minimum tail inner equal-person MAE among feasible candidates; ties overall MAE, lower factor, earlier epoch
tail: SPPB<=3 or TUG>20, visit-defined descriptive groups
inner: exact reference three person folds; overall combined by all validation people counts, tail by qualifying validation people counts
outer: exact reference five person folds; no held-out predictions used to choose factors, epochs, seeds or fallback
input: same 4..10 and 30..60 second bands, 1/3/5 bouts, four bout features; train draw0, assess draws0/1/2 separately
loss_scaling: reference person weights times tail factor, globally normalized; preprocessing unchanged and based on train people only
search: all three weighted candidates trained to600 and evaluated every10; no adaptive pruning
evaluation: unboosted equal-person MAE/bias/RMSE/p90; paired five-seed mean errors, no ensemble; report outer violations rather than claiming guaranteed noninferiority
